arguments.sql: SELECT m.id AS merchant_id, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions t JOIN merchants m ON t.merchant_id = m.id GROUP BY m.id ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, m.id ASC LIMIT 5
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions per merchant and returns the five merchants with the most, highest first, with their ids.
assumptions: Counted all transactions regardless of whether they have a fraud label.
Ties in transaction count are broken by merchant id ascending.
